articles.title: US seeks bids to exchange 17 million barrels of crude from strategic reserve
articles.summary: The United States plans to release 17 million barrels of crude oil from its Strategic Petroleum Reserve. This action aims to alleviate fuel price pressures amid disruptions caused by the war with Iran.

articles.title: India’s 10-year bond yield may rise to 7.6% as US Treasury yields remain elevated: SBI Research
articles.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield witnessed a sharp intraday spike on October 14, crossing 5.32% after higher-than-expected inflation data revived expectations of further monetary tightening by the US Federal Reserve.

articles.title: Middle east war hits Indian fuel retailers: OMCs losing up to Rs 30 per litre, says report
articles.summary: Indian oil marketing firms are grappling with significant losses, facing Rs 26 loss per litre for petrol and Rs 30 for diesel. The turmoil in West Asia has led to skyrocketing procurement and freight costs, rising eightfold, which heavily influences overall expenditures.

articles.title: India flags trade concerns, market access barriers; China reacts
articles.summary: China has acknowledged India's concerns regarding trade barriers and the growing trade deficit during recent discussions. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted India's challenges in accessing the Chinese market for its products.

articles.title: Copper supply could peak before demand: Why a 30% shortfall is hard to fix
articles.summary: Global copper supply could struggle to keep pace with rising demand from AI data centres, power grids and electric vehicles, with projections pointing to a potential 30% shortfall by 2035.

articles.title: India's $100 billion China trade deficit: Are non-tariff barriers blocking Indian exports?
articles.summary: Speaking at an interaction in Bangkok, Sitharaman said China's restrictions were preventing Indian products from realising their potential in one of the world's largest markets.

articles.title: Jaishankar, Marco Rubio to hold talks in Mumbai on October 20; energy cooperation on agenda
articles.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed the meeting on Friday, saying the discussions would focus on bolstering the Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership between the two countries.

articles.title: Festive spending in urban India to drop 6% to ₹1.97 lakh crore amid inflation: Survey
articles.summary: Urban India's festive spending is projected to fall 6% to ₹1.97 lakh crore in 2026, with households budgeting an average of nearly ₹20,000 amid rising inflation and borrowing costs, according to a LocalCircles survey.

articles.title: AI revenue is surging at Indian IT firms, but how much is adding to growth?
articles.summary: TCS, HCLTech and other IT firms are reporting sharp growth in AI businesses, but modest overall revenue growth raises questions over whether AI is generating fresh demand or cannibalising traditional IT services.

articles.title: Return of Middle East oil: Has Iran lost control of Hormuz & why are crude prices still up?
articles.summary: The US war with Iran exposed Tehran’s ability to disrupt the global economy by blocking the Strait of Hormuz. Before the war, around 19 million barrels of crude oil were exported daily from the Middle East.

articles.title: How much gold and silver can you legally keep at home?
articles.summary: In a recent case before the ITAT Mumbai, the Income Tax Department carried out searches at a woman's residence and bank lockers, and seized diamonds, gold and silver articles, along with jewellery, which it treated as unexplained assets.

articles.title: Before Jio's 2016 launch, a failed assignment triggered a digital ambition, Isha Ambani says
articles.summary: Speaking at a briefing on Jio Platforms' upcoming initial public offering (IPO) on Thursday, Isha said the idea took shape around 2009-2010, when she and her brother Akash Ambani were studying in the US and had returned to Mumbai for a break.

articles.title: India to overtake Japan as world’s fourth-largest economy in 2027: IMF projections
articles.summary: The outlook comes as the IMF raised its forecast for India’s economic growth in 2026 to 7%, reflecting continued momentum despite challenging global conditions.

articles.title: Indian billionaire family offices ramp up AI bets as funding rises 50% in 2026: Report
articles.summary: Indian billionaire family offices and wealthy investors have increased their AI investments by nearly 50% in 2026 to around $760 million. The funding push comes as India seeks to build homegrown AI companies and narrow its investment gap with the US and China.

articles.title: Still searching for a train to Bihar? Check these extra festive services before making your Chhath travel plans
articles.summary: Heading home to Bihar for Chhath? Check announced festival-special routes from Bengaluru, Gujarat, Delhi and other cities, their service windows and the booking details to confirm first.

articles.title: Delhi Metro to start at 3:30 am on October 18, but only these 4 lines will run early
articles.summary: Delhi Metro will start at 3:30 am on October 18 for the Delhi Half Marathon. Check early train timings, routes and schedules for Red, Yellow, Blue and Violet lines before you travel.

articles.title: BT Explainer: What the SC verdict on Yes Bank’s AT-1 bonds means for the lender and will it alter AT1 bonds as such?
articles.summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday ordered the restoration of Yes Bank’s Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds, which the lender has said will impact its CET-1 capital ratio by 250 bps, including profits.

articles.title: Tesla's flying Roadster promises 96 kmph in under a second, but there's a big catch
articles.summary: Tesla's redesigned Roadster promises 0-96 kmph in under 0.59 seconds, SpaceX-inspired thrusters, aerial stunts and over 483 km range. But production is not expected before 2028.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu unlinks semiconductor incentives from Centre’s approval, offers hiring and local sourcing benefits
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu Semiconductor Ecosystem Scheme 2026, released on Thursday, offers two incentive tracks. The first covers projects approved under the Centre’s Semicon 2.0 programme, with State assistance over and above Central support.

articles.title: IDBI Bank sale to close by fiscal-end after RBI clearance: DIPAM Secretary
articles.summary: The government on Wednesday approved the sale of a 60.72 per cent stake in IDBI Bank to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings for about ₹53,000 crore.

articles.title: Ahead of Jio IPO, Reliance releases October salary 15 days early to encourage investment: Report
articles.summary: The company is looking to expand participation in the offering by turning employees, and potentially their family members, into shareholders of Jio Platforms

articles.title: RBI broadens Rupee defence beyond dollar sales, turns to tighter monetary conditions: Report
articles.summary: The RBI raised policy rates this month for the first time in four years and has drained liquidity through bond sales and tighter reserve requirements for banks and large foreign-exchange hedging transactions.

articles.title: Fresh MoUs And Trade Push: India, Canada ink Karnataka deals; CEPA talks eyed by end-2026
articles.summary: In a significant move to boost economic relations, India and Canada have recently established various commercial agreements during the Canada-India Business Ceremony held in Karnataka. These agreements aim to foster enhanced collaboration between businesses in both nations.

articles.title: He paid Rs 15 lakh for Rs 10 lakh flat; builder demanded Rs 20 lakh more, buyer wins case
articles.summary: A man, who was working in the US, booked a 1,208-square-foot flat along with a car parking space in Patna. The booking was confirmed in 2005, and the agreement for sale was signed in 2007. The total price agreed upon for the flat and parking space was Rs 10,41,250.

articles.title: IMF Warns On Energy Risks: Middle East conflict could stoke India inflation; growth, fisc at risk
articles.summary: India could face inflationary pressures if the Middle East conflict results in sustained high energy prices. The International Monetary Fund warns that prolonged energy price increases could slow economic growth, raise living costs, and worsen fiscal balances.

articles.title: India’s FY27 growth seen at 7.1–7.3%, but private investment must pick up: Deloitte
articles.summary: The report said household spending and public investment in infrastructure have supported India's growth over the past decade.

articles.title: Gold could hit record highs by 2028 as central banks ramp up buying: Report
articles.summary: Gold prices could hit fresh record highs by 2028 as central-bank buying and geopolitical uncertainty support demand for the precious metal. However, US inflation, interest-rate expectations and currency movements continue to influence near-term gold and silver prices.

articles.title: Tech Mahindra jumps 8%, IT firm adds Rs 11,000 crore to market cap after Q2 earnings
articles.summary: Tech Mahindra witnessed an impressive surge of over 8% in its shares following the announcement of remarkable quarterly earnings. The IT giant recorded a 32.74% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, buoyed by robust volume growth and effective cost management.

articles.title: Why Netflix fired content chief Bela Bajaria from the seat of power
articles.summary: Bela Bajaria’s departure was announced alongside the appointment of Peter Rice, the former Walt Disney Company general entertainment chairman, as her replacement.

articles.title: Air India cancels all flights to and from three Saudi cities till October 20
articles.summary: In response to the escalating conflict, Air India has halted all flights to and from Saudi Arabia until October 20. This decision aligns with similar suspensions by other carriers such as Air France-KLM and Gulf Air.

articles.title: FM Sitharaman seeks early India-US trade deal, flags China’s market access barriers
articles.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the need to finalize the India-US trade agreement for enhanced bilateral relations. She expressed concerns over the trade imbalance with China and non-tariff barriers obstructing market access.

articles.title: Rupee gains 20 paise against US dollar as RBI support kicks in, greenback weakens
articles.summary: On Friday, the Rupee showcased a solid performance, climbing 20 paise to hit 94.79 against the US dollar, building on gains from the previous day aided by a softer dollar and actions by the Reserve Bank of India.

articles.title: India raises petrol export duty fivefold to Rs 2.5/litre, cuts diesel levy to Rs 8.5
articles.summary: In a recent policy shift, the Indian government has raised the export duty on petrol to Rs 2.5 per litre while reducing the diesel duty to Rs 8.5 per litre.

articles.title: Taxman capped LIC retiree's leave pay exemption at Rs 3 lakh; ITAT allows Rs 9.04 lakh
articles.summary: A woman retired from Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) on June 30, 2020 after more than 30 years of service. She received Rs 9.04 lakh as leave encashment, in addition to her other retirement benefits.

articles.title: 'Welcome competition including Starlink': Reliance reacts to Musk's comments
articles.summary: Reliance Industries has welcomed the entry of Elon Musk's Starlink into the Indian satellite communications market. The company clarified that it has never feared competition and is also awaiting clearances for its satellite services.

Stock recommendations: What are the top stocks to buy or sell on October 16, 2026?
articles.summary: Stock market recommendations: Aarti Industries, and Blue Star are the top stocks to buy today on October 16, 2026 as picked by Hitesh Rathi, Technical Analyst (Equity & Derivatives) at Angel One.

articles.title: Oil prices dip marginally as US weighs easing sanctions on ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
articles.summary: Amid fluctuating oil markets, current tensions in the Middle East and possible shifts in US sanctions have resulted in a marginal decline in oil prices. WTI crude is priced at $97.31, with Brent crude at $105.40.
